persons.name: Bhūpārendramalla
persons.evidence: śrī bhūpārendra malla thākulana thva kāryya yāka juro

persons.name: Śivanārāyaṇa
persons.evidence: ivāhārayā śivanārāyaṇācāryyana thva ghaṃtha coya madhuṃko

persons.name: Yaśodhara
persons.evidence: vaṃlānihma gṛha nivāsita vipra śrījaśodharana saṃpūrṇa yāṅana coyā dina juro

notes: The colophon contains two dates: NS 820 vaiśākha kṛṣṇa 13 (Sunday) recording the staging/bringing out of the drama (pyākhana pidaṅa dina) involving king Yoganarendra Malla of Patan (Eraya = Yala), the king of Bhaktapur (Khopo), and king Bhūpārendra Malla of Kathmandu; and an earlier date NS 740 vaiśākha śukla 13 (Monday) (ca. 1620 CE) recording the completion of copying by Yaśodhara after Śivanārāyaṇa left it unfinished.
